name: agentuse
description: AgentUse on your own computer, through AgentUse Cloud: automate turns this work into an agent that runs on its own, triage fixes agents that fail.

interface.shortDescription: Turn this work into an agent that runs on its own.
interface.longDescription: Connects to AgentUse Cloud, which reaches AgentUse on your own computer. Use automate to turn a workflow from this conversation into an agent you review and turn on with one click, and triage to find and fix agents that fail. Your agents run on your computer, with your keys. Connect the computer once with the AgentUse app or `agentuse connect`.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentUse to automate the workflow we just completed.
Use AgentUse to run this every weekday morning.
Use AgentUse to find and fix my failing agents.
